positive:
Clean black-and-white manga line art for a print coloring-book style children's manga. Bold, closed outlines; flat white background areas ready for coloring; clear silhouettes; consistent character proportions; expressive but simple faces; readable panel-friendly compositions; no screentones; no gray washes; no painterly shading; high contrast ink lines only.

COLORING BOOK RULES:
- Pure white backgrounds / open regions suitable for hand coloring
- Closed shapes with continuous black outlines
- No filled black areas larger than hair/eyes accents unless specified
- No grayscale gradients, hatching-as-shade, or photographic texture
- Leave clear negative space for speech balloons and captions (text added later)
- Keep important details inside safe margins

CHARACTERS:
- Kaito: face_shape: Soft oval with a gently pointed chin; youthful cheeks that can flush; not round-chibi and not sharp-adult; eye_shape: Large, expressive almond eyes with clear upper lids; irises readable in line art; strong catchlights when hopeful or amazed; hairstyle: Messy spiky hair with uneven clumps; several forward spikes over the forehead; sides a bit shorter; looks like he forgot a comb but on purpose; hair_silhouette: Irregular spiky crown; highest spikes slightly off-center; readable dark outline even when hood is up (hood rarely fully covers spikes); approximate_height: About 160–165 cm (average early-teen height); reads slightly lanky next to peers; outfit: Hooded jacket over a plain casual shirt or light undershirt, practical trousers, sneakers; jacket: Casual zip-up hooded jacket

LOCATION: neighbourhood_street

PAGE: page_03 (story page 3). Walk to school

SCENE: Kaito walks familiar streets, sketchbook corner sticking from bag; he notices a poster for the school art festival

EMOTION: mild curiosity, slight dread

CAMERA: Street establishing shot; medium on Kaito reading poster

CONTINUITY: Match locked references. Keep costume and props consistent.

Continuity from previous: ['bag with sketchbook', 'jacket worn']
